# New in Verda’s Instant clusters: Slurm on Kubernetes, Audit logs, Health checks 

 Sep 10, 2026 | Paul Chang & Alexander Rozhkov | 5 min read 

 Deploying a GPU cluster is not just about the hardware. It's about the tooling (or a lack thereof) that helps you get the most out of the cluster.

That feedback loop steers our product roadmap, and it is exactly why we know what must be improved before we get a feature request. 

 In 2026 so far, this loop produced multiple improvements to our Instant clusters: more comprehensive workload management, layered health checks, faster access to container images, audit logging, and flexible provisioning. More additions are on the way. 

 This post covers what we shipped. Later installments in the series go deeper on each. 

## Instant clusters, a recap 

 You can deploy GPU clusters with self-service access: no approvals, quotas, or sales calls. 

 The latest GPU accelerators are available at up to 144× NVIDIA HGX™ B300, 128× NVIDIA HGX™ B200, and 64× NVIDIA HGX™ H200 per cluster, all on InfiniBand. NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 is also available in configurations from 2× to 18× trays. Each tray contains 4× NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs and 2× NVIDIA Grace CPUs. 

 If you need clusters with more GPUs and custom configurations, contact us. 

 Instant clusters are provisioned in as little as 20 minutes and available with pay-as-you-go contracts, giving you maximum flexibility for rapid deployments.

# Verda rated Bronze in SemiAnalysis's ClusterMAX™ 3.0 

 Sep 25, 2026 | Mukund Birje | 2 min read 

 SemiAnalysis released its ClusterMAX™ 3.0 ratings this week, and Verda was rated Bronze. Of the 77 neoclouds put through full testing, only 19 landed a ‘recommended AI cloud provider’ medallion rating this cycle, down from 41 last time. We're one of them.

...

Our instant clusters keep scaling as well. You can now deploy up to 144 NVIDIA HGX™ B300 GPUs, 128 B200, or 64 H200 per cluster on InfiniBand, alongside GB300 NVL72 configurations from two trays up to eighteen. Instant clusters are provisioned in as little as 15 minutes and available with pay-as-you-go contracts, giving you maximum flexibility for rapid deployments.

...

Writing about Verda's trajectory more broadly, SemiAnalysis said they remain "optimistic about their engineering team and roadmap." That roadmap runs deeper than the cluster layer. The same week this rating was published, we announced a $189M Series B to extend that capacity across Europe, the US, and Asia and to go deeper on the platform itself including object storage, managed kubernetes, and networking.

## Service Disruption Affecting Some Instances, Storage Volumes, and Billing 

 Sep 25, 2026 at 1:08pm UTC 

Affected services Finland-01 Finland-02 Finland-03

 Resolved Sep 25, 2026 at 4:02pm UTC 

The issue affecting a small number of instances, storage volumes, and billing records across FIN-01, FIN-02, and FIN-03 has been resolved. Affected records have been restored, and any applicable billing corrections are being processed. We apologize for the disruption and thank you for your patience.

...

Earlier today, a technical issue affected a small number of customers across FIN-01, FIN-02, and FIN-03. Some customers may have experienced unavailable VM instances or storage volumes, or incorrect balance deductions.

The issue has been contained and no additional customers are being affected. Our team is restoring the affected records, reviewing billing impact, and investigating the root cause to prevent similar incidents going forward.
